crossRefs.note: People went out to see what had happened. They came to Jesus and found the man from whom the demons had gone out…
In Hades, he lifted up his eyes, being in torment, and saw Abraham far off, and Lazarus at his bosom.
As a dream when one wakes up, so, Lord, when you awake, you will despise their fantasies.
This is an evil in all that is done under the sun, that there is one event to all: yes also, the heart of the sons of…
Surely after that I was turned. I repented. After that I was instructed. I struck my thigh. I was ashamed, yes, even…
Because he considers, and turns away from all his transgressions that he has committed, he shall surely live. He shall…
Now when they heard this, they were cut to the heart, and said to Peter and the rest of the apostles, “Brothers, what…
He called for lights, sprang in, fell down trembling before Paul and Silas,
brought them out, and said, “Sirs, what must I do to be saved?”
Punishing them often in all the synagogues, I tried to make them blaspheme. Being exceedingly enraged against them, I…
But God, being rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us,
even when we were dead through our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ—by grace you have been saved—
Therefore he says, “Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”
But when the kindness of God our Savior and his love toward mankind appeared,
Don’t be deceived, my beloved brothers.
I will get up and go to my father, and will tell him, “Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in your sight.
I am no more worthy to be called your son. Make me as one of your hired servants.” ’
Jerusalem remembers in the days of her affliction and of her miseries all her pleasant things that were from the days…

translations.web: But when he came to himself he said, ‘How many hired servants of my father’s have bread enough to spare, and I’m dying with hunger!
translations.bsb: Finally he came to his senses and said, ‘How many of my father’s hired servants have plenty of food, but here I am, starving to death!
translations.kjv: And when he came to himself, he said, How many hired servants of my father's have bread enough and to spare, and I perish with hunger!
translations.asv: But when he came to himself he said, How many hired servants of my father's have bread enough and to spare, and I perish here with hunger!
